known_limitations: Lasso produces IC=0.000 in non-macro experiments — possible implementation issue with alpha tuning
Bootstrap p-values may be unreliable (some show exactly 0.000)
Single test period (2022-2026) — no walk-forward validation
No portfolio construction or economic validation
Macro features are slow-moving (monthly/quarterly) — may not capture intra-month regime changes
